items.title: 53342_Cozy Cole oral history interview
items.q: I took a trio to the Onyx which consisted of Johnny, Hank D'Amico and me.

ctx.x: They brought him in to play with the house rhythm section at a place called Bourbon Street which is a club up there, jazz club. He still plays very well. He's doing a lot of things in 5-4.
Yeah, Johnny's a great pianist. Yeah, he can mimic Fats Waller down to the nth degree.
Yeah, really small hands, too, for a piano player.
